leadText: Lombre (Japanese: ハスブレロ Hasubrero) is a non-player character in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team and their remake, Rescue Team DX.
plainText:
Lombre (Japanese: ハスブレロ Hasubrero) is a non-player character in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team and their remake, Rescue Team DX.

==In the games==

Lombre is a resident of Pokémon Square who is friendly with the and partner. He was hesitant in attacking the hero when the residents were told that the hero was causing the natural disasters but did so anyway (though he does not attack them in the remake). He then took part in the chase of them. He was happy to find out that they were cleared of all charges and welcomed them back. When called lots of rescue teams together, Lombre stopped the hero and their partner volunteering to go and fight as there were more experienced rescue teams there.

Lombre was later at Hill of the Ancients where he celebrated with the hero and partner when they helped to get the falling star destroyed.

After the credits roll, Lombre is part of the conversations that let the player unlock Stormy Sea. He can also tell the team about Buried Relic's buried items when it becomes the focus of the Pokémon Square's talk.
 
===Appearance===
 

==In the manga==
===In the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team manga===
Lombre appeared in I Want to be Human Again!.
 

==In animation==
 ]]
In Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!, Lombre was at Whiscash Pond together with , , and . Along with the others, he overheard a 's worries about his older brother . When Team Meanies showed up and proposed to rescue Pikachu, Lombre discussed with Bellsprout and Snubbull what the of Team Meanies would be. Lombre guessed it would be higher than Normal Rank.
